S2a-2 SEAM DRAFT (bd-01M379MH86VMN6SNVNRH32G3G6), for objection before I build. Base: solo/s2a1b. A subagent mapped every read of the five scorers; the full map is in mote.

What the scorers actually read. Nothing reads ordinal/span/text/grounding/expressedUncertainty, or discoursePosition/support/scoringPosition/worldOrder/adjacency. Only fromTable reads ids, so it stays historical-only.
- UNIT: function, plus the sketch's predicate, participants (role, specified, names), polarity, modality, outcome, sensoryTerms and lemmas, plus the chart.
- NODE: level/isLeaf, predicate, participants (role, names), context, polarity, modality, outcome, lemmas, chart, hasEvidence; also maxLevel over the view.
- MEMBERS: structuralMembers (sortBy ref) for chart reduction and coverage; leavesUnder (storage order) for the ModeGate segment path.

Contract (align, new file content.scala):
- A phantom OrderPolicy: Canonical | Source. Source's projection is private[align] and exists only for the historical shims.
- UnitContent[O]: function; SketchContent (the fields above, with participants as (role, specified, names), NO RecallEntityId); graph: Option[SemanticGraph[G(O)]], keeping missing and empty distinct.
- TargetContent[O]: level, the content fields above, graph, and a Members[O].
- Members[O]: no public iteration. It offers only library reductions: minOf, count, exists and contradictions. Under Canonical, contradictions return a SortedSet by content key, so storage order never reaches Admissibility. Under Source they reproduce the historical Vector order exactly, for parity.
- ContentGrain: maxLevel.
- ContentProjection.canonical(unit, node, view): Either[ProjectionRefusal, (UnitContent, TargetContent, ContentGrain)]. It refuses when a chart's canonical budget runs out. There is no id fallback.
- All of them are final non-case classes with private[align] construction, and a court in storymodel4s.probes.
Ported scorer signatures (each historical entry point = project Source, then delegate):
- lexical(u: UnitContent[O], t: TargetContent[O]): Estimate[Double]
- contradictions(u, t): Vector|SortedSet (per O)
- chartReduction(u, t, grain)
- modeGate(u, t)
- cost(u, t, mode, grain)
Falsifiers: every parity pin byte-identical (S2a-0, LocalEvidenceParityProbe, CostSuite literals, WOG goldens, MappingCodecDigest); plus a court proving that the content types expose no id, span, text, order or support.
Open questions for you:
(a) Should Canonical contradictions be a SortedSet, or a multiset with counts (does multiplicity matter)?
(b) Should SketchContent keep `locations`, `times` and `cause`, which no scorer reads today? I'd drop them (the ADR says to keep the payload minimal).
